title: The Secret of the Sun Lantern Seeds
moral: The best treasures are meant to be shared with kindness and friendship.

story:
Ollie the otter loved the river and the gentle sounds of nature. One morning, while playing with his friends Saffy the squirrel, Bree the rabbit, and Timo the tortoise, he discovered a green glass bottle hidden among the reeds. Inside was a rolled-up map with clues leading to a treasure.

Excited, the friends decided to follow the map together. Their first clue led them to a large oak tree with a heart-shaped knot. They carefully crossed a log over the river and counted three stones, finding a hidden wooden disk with the next clue.

Continuing their journey, they crossed a wobbly bridge and made their way toward a waterfall. When part of the map got smudged, they stayed calm and used their memory and teamwork to find the right path by listening to the sound of the water.

Behind the waterfall, they discovered a cave filled with glowing lights. Inside, they solved a puzzle with three shells by turning them in the correct order. This opened a hidden door leading to a peaceful glen.

In the center of the glen, they found a treasure chest. When they opened it, they discovered Sun Lantern Seeds, Star Sprinkles, and Laughing Dew instead of gold or jewels.

The note explained that the seeds would grow into glowing flowers if planted with care and song. The friends realized the treasure was meant to be shared.

They planted the seeds near the river and sang together. As night fell, glowing flowers bloomed and filled the forest with warm light and gentle music.

Animals from all around gathered to see the magical glow. Ollie and his friends felt proud and happy, knowing they had shared something special.

They understood that the greatest treasure was not something to keep, but something to share with others.
